mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions ( store_id, plan_id, status, billing_amount, version ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{planId}, #{status}, #{billingAmount}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, plan_id, status, billing_amount, started_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, next_billing_at, past_due_at, canceled_at, expired_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status IN ( 'PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'CANCELED' ) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, store_id, plan_id, status, billing_amount, started_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, next_billing_at, past_due_at, canceled_at, expired_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM subscriptions WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE subscriptions SET status = 'ACTIVE', started_at = #{startedAt}, current_period_start = #{periodStart}, current_period_end = #{periodEnd}, next_billing_at = #{nextBillingAt}, past_due_at = NULL, version = #{nextVersion} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE subscriptions SET status = 'ACTIVE', current_period_start = #{periodStart}, current_period_end = #{periodEnd}, next_billing_at = #{nextBillingAt}, past_due_at = NULL, version = #{nextVersion} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAST_DUE'
UPDATE subscriptions SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, next_billing_at = NULL, version = #{nextVersion} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE subscriptions SET status = 'EXPIRED', canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, next_billing_at = NULL, version = #{nextVersion} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PAST_DUE')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND current_period_end <= #{now} ORDER BY current_period_end, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'CANCELED' AND current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND current_period_end <= #{now} ORDER BY current_period_end, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'PAST_DUE' AND past_due_at IS NOT NULL AND past_due_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY past_due_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
